name: Annikki Nieminen
bio:
Annikki's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aerodynamics, sparked by watching rally races in her hometown. She pursued mechanical engineering at Tampere University, specializing in fluid dynamics. After graduating, she interned at a local automotive company before landing a position at ART Grand Prix. She quickly demonstrated an exceptional aptitude for interpreting wind tunnel data and translating it into tangible performance improvements on track.

Annikki is known for her meticulous approach to data analysis and her ability to identify subtle aerodynamic nuances. She is driven by a desire to optimize every aspect of the car's performance. She is not afraid to challenge conventional thinking and is always looking for innovative ways to improve the car's aerodynamic efficiency. She is a valuable asset to the ART Grand Prix team.

What sets Annikki apart is her unwavering commitment to precision and her relentless pursuit of aerodynamic perfection. She is a firm believer that even the smallest details can make a significant difference, and she instills this belief in her colleagues.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Annikki is of average height with a lean build, her piercing blue eyes always focused on the task at hand.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Insists on a perfectly clean workspace before starting any wind tunnel session.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
